configurable_props.name: emailTypeOption
configurable_props.label: Email type option
configurable_props.description:
Whether the list supports [multiple formats for emails](https://mailchimp.com/help/change-audience-name-defaults/).
        When set to true, subscribers can choose whether they want to receive HTML or plain-text emails. 
        When set to false, subscribers will receive HTML emails, with a plain-text alternative backup.
